pairs.why: B has the recessed ring groove around the button and soft darker rim, like the real card's nested panel grooves, while A's body is edge-poor.
A keeps broader, softer gold bands with fewer fine contour lines, closer to the real chest's chunky soft-edged rim, while B adds finer crisp coin and plank edges.
A wraps the backrest and seat in a bright lime piping that reads as a drawn outline, which the real chair lacks; B's edges are plain fabric folds and thin seams.
A has soft rounded paper edges and fewer sharp crease lines, like the real card's thick soft white rim, while B's crisp folds and scalloped edges add more edge density.
Both chairs have similar crisp piping, stitching and tube edges, with no clear difference in outline or edge hierarchy.
A has softer, fewer edges in the background and a smoother body, but its dense grille adds some edge noise; B has crisper rivets and many pebbles and bushes.
B's boot has smooth, soft contours with few internal lines, like the real cards' simple forms, while A adds many seam and panel lines and a strong dark sole edge.
B has soft, rounded panel gaps with a clean separation between body, glass and wheels, like the real taxi, while A's hard rivets and thin metal arms are crisp and sharper.
